newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westpac Invest. fixed interest appointment.
newsitem.headline: Westpac Invest. fixed interest appointment.

text.p: Westpac Investment Management (WIM) said on Friday that it has appointed Ashley Perrott to the position of investment director fixed interest.

Perrott was previously director of fixed interest investments at Barclay Global Investors, and prior to that he was responsible for management of the fixed interest portfolios of the Individually Managed funds at AMP Investment.
The group now has over A$6.0 billion in treasury and fixed interest management and has targeted growth of more than A$2.0 billion a year.

"Mr Perrott's appointment is a key step in translating this ambition into reality. He has a wealth of experience in fixed interest funds management, with an impressive track record," said WIM managing director Ian Macoun.
